final_message: Fixed `installments()` in `src/ledger/installments.py:15-17` so the last instalment is computed as `total - share * (count - 1)` instead of repeating the floor-rounded share, matching the function's own docstring. Added a regression test for splitting 100.00 into 3 (`[33.33, 33.33, 33.34]`, summing exactly to 100.00). Full suite: 67 passed.
